The '''Promenade of Seven Guilds''' was the main thoroughfare in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. It was located in the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Civic Level/Legends|Civic Level]], and also served as a ceremonial avenue.<ref name="Complete Locations" />
